columns.label: Re-charged from other funds

columns.label: Left

columns.label: Paid by other funds, re-charged later

columns.label: Paid by other funds, from the start

text.an_note: Bars are what each payee or memo was paid this year, split by the fund that paid. Re-charges are left out: they move bills between funds and pay nobody.
text.an_week_note: Each bar is one week, Monday to Sunday, everything paid or still owed that week, by fund. A bar below the line is a week bills were re-charged off the school budget. The shaded span is the fiscal year; anything to its left was posted before it began.

Payroll rows are whole pay runs, with no names. A bill re-charged to another fund is listed twice: taken off the school budget, and under the fund that paid it.

text.mv_transfers_def: Permission to spend, moved between lines by a vote or an approved transfer. No bill moves; the budget does.
text.no_recharges: No bills re-charged to or from another fund.
text.none: No other fund paid toward this line.
text.other_funds: Other funds: grants, the circuit breaker, fees and revolving funds, and capital articles. Re-charges are the Town’s own entries; which spending counts as paid from the start toward a line is our match, by payee or by kind of work.
text.payers: Other funds that paid toward this line
text.read: Other funds can pay a line’s bills in two ways, and only one of them changes Left. The school budget can pay first and a journal entry RE-CHARGE the bills to a grant or another fund later: the school budget’s spending falls and Left rises, and the line cost the same. Or the other fund can pay FROM THE START: Left is untouched, and the line cost more than the school budget shows. Hover or tap a circled amount to see each entry.

text.bills_h: How many bills, and how big
text.bills_line: For each payee: how many invoices it sent, and the middle invoice’s amount. More invoices and bigger invoices are different causes. A count of invoices is not a count of children: one invoice can cover a part of a year, or more than one child.
text.compare_line: The same years and the same scale across each row, so the two lines compare directly: the children placed, the budget, and what it cost by who paid.
text.counts_def: A day placement: the child attends that school and comes home each night. Residential: the child lives at the school. Both are private schools; a collaborative is a public programme run jointly by several districts.
text.counts_line: Children in out-of-district placements on 1 March, as the annual town report prints them, by kind of placement. A count of children, not of dollars: no cost per child is drawn from it.
text.counts_missing: not printed in the reports held
text.counts_ours: Reading collaborative placements against the collaborative tuition line, and day and residential against private tuitions, is ours: the report does not tie its counts to budget lines. It rests on who was paid -- the collaborative line paid only collaboratives, the private line only private schools and providers.
text.counts_unheld: no annual town report for this year is in the archive yet
text.failed: Could not load this page’s data.
text.fund_what: A fund other than the school budget that spent money on the schools: where its money went, what it bought, every posting.
text.hist_rule: A budget is what was allowed and spending is what happened: they are drawn side by side, never added into one series.
text.kinds_h: What kind of bill, by year
text.kinds_line: This year’s bills, next year’s paid early, and orders still owed at year end, kept apart: a jump can be a year paying for two.
text.left_note: Left is the budget less what the school budget itself spent. Money another fund paid counts toward the cost but not against the budget, so Left can be larger than the gap between the budget line and the top of the bar.
text.line_what: One line of the school budget: what Town Meeting voted for it, what it spent, and what other funds paid toward it.
text.memos_change: Largest changes, by payee and kind of bill
text.memos_line: Each bill sorted by words in its memo. The grouping is ours: a keyword list, shown below, first match wins. The town’s system cuts a memo at about 18 characters and the wording changes year to year, so the words themselves cannot be compared; the groups can.
text.mv_awards: Each year’s awards side by side, with what they spent, and every entry that re-booked cost from one of its awards to another.
text.mv_awards_h: Its awards, and cost moved between them
text.mv_none_awards: No entry moved cost between its awards in these years.
text.not_this_year: Not on the books this year.
text.payees_line: Every fund. The payees it paid most across the years, by name; the rest together.
text.payers_group: Each fund other than the school budget that paid toward any of these lines: what it put on them, and what it put on other school lines the same year.
text.payers_line: Each fund other than the school budget that paid toward this line in any year: what it put here, and what it put on other school lines the same year. The bar is everything the fund spent on school lines that year, darker where it was spent here.
text.r_spend: What it cost, by who paid
text.r_years_note: This year’s tuition bills divided by the annual rate: how many years of tuition the bills add up to, roughly. Not children: two half-years make one, and some bills are for other programmes at other prices.
text.rates_line: What the collaborative’s own rate sheet prints each year, beside what this line was billed. Pairing the payee with the sheet is ours; it rests on the invoices matching the printed rate.
text.shifts_line: Each line, each year, wherever budget or bills moved. Hover a heading for what it means.
text.sources_note: Every figure is from the school journal and ties to the Town’s period-13 report.
text.split_line: One chart per fund other than the school budget: each year’s bar is everything it spent on school lines, split by which of these lines it paid, and the rest.
text.web_fund: Centre: this fund (each award, where a programme has several). Right: where its money went. Left: bills moved back onto it from a school line.
text.web_line: Left: the funds that paid toward this line, and lines that gave it budget. Right: funds bills were moved back to, and lines it gave budget to.
text.web_none: Nothing connects to it this year but what is shown.
text.web_ours: Paid from the start and same kind of work are our matches; re-charges and moves are the Town’s own entries.
